note: Computed-style probe baseline (css-migration-plan.md §6). `npm run css:probe` dumps the resolved getComputedStyle of a fixed probe list across a fixed set of panel states and diffs it against this file; any difference fails, and `npm run css:probe:update` accepts the new values. Colours are normalised to 8-bit `rgb(r g b / a)` so a `color-mix()` — which Chrome serialises as `color(srgb …)` — compares equal to the `rgba()` it replaced. Each probe is one line, `count=N;property=value;…`, so the file stays readable; the tool still reports a diff per property.
